reply.emotion: warm and bright, looking forward to sunny days and long evenings
notes: In traditional or poetic Russian, лето can also mean 'year' (as in сколько вам лет? — how old are you?).

senses.definition: The warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn.

examples.text: Мы поедем на море этим летом.
examples.translation: We will go to the sea this summer.
examples.emotion: excited and cheerful, planning a wonderful vacation

definitions: The warmest season of the year, coming between spring and autumn.
